lead: Final test of 0.8.35 (CI test build 40745427793). risk.py: class C on all three systems, so from the core list only the automated runs (hil: cold start, reopen, export). The round's own items: library drag and drop, Init Patch, note timing with the original's head start (3072 samples), controllers from the DAW (#18), the REAPER Play fix, the graph and arpeggiator editing (#19), and the Snow plug-in (on the Mac also as Audio Unit). Linux was checked with dev builds during the round; Windows has seen nothing of this round yet. Mark each item, add a note where something looks different, then copy the results at the bottom into the chat.
rules: Order: Linux first (the Virus is on this PC), then the Windows VM, then the Mac. Close the DAW before the Virus moves.
Never power-cycle the Virus while it is attached to the VM; switch it off and on only while it is on Linux.
Use a disposable project. Do not save over stored patches on the Virus.

sections.title: Linux
sections.where: REAPER 7.83, Virus on this PC, CI build 0.8.35 (installed with install.sh)
prep: Claude installs the CI build and runs hil.sh (cold start, reopen, export, broker killed while playing).

items.title: REAPER Play/Stop on the CI build
steps: REAPER, a project with TI Revive and a few notes: press Play and Stop about 10 times.
items.expect: No sync error page; notes in time. Claude counts 'sync report' lines in diag.log (0 or a few at Stop, not one per Play).

items.title: Library by drag and drop
steps: Drag a library .mid or .syx from the file manager onto the plug-in's browser.
items.expect: It shows under Personal Libraries at once, with names; a patch from it plays and the Virus shows 'LIB'.

sections.title: Windows 11 (VM)
sections.where: win11 VM, Ableton Live 11, CI build 0.8.35 (installed silently by Claude)
prep: Claude installs the build in the VM, attaches the Virus and copies the hil-windows kit.

items.title: hil-win on the new build
steps: Run hil-win.cmd (about 5 minutes); Claude grades the result folder on Linux.
items.expect: Cold start, reopen and export pass (drift in the VM is not judged, E334).

items.title: Sound, timing and the mod wheel in Live 11
steps: Live 11, TI Revive on a MIDI track: play a clip with short notes, then draw a mod wheel (CC 1) envelope on a patch that uses it.
items.expect: Notes in time, no crackle, no sync error page; the mod wheel is audible.

items.title: Init Patch, drag and drop, browser
steps: LOAD > Init Patch, then Revert to; drag a library .mid from Explorer onto the browser; step through libraries with the bank arrows.
items.expect: Init sound, Revert brings the old one back; the library shows at once with names; the arrows step through the libraries.

items.title: Graph and arpeggiator editing (#19)
steps: Drag a line and a handle in a filter envelope display (Shift: finer, Ctrl+click: middle).
ARP page, user pattern: change one step's length and velocity, Alt+click a step, try shift/randomize and the right-click menu.
items.expect: Works as on Linux: the line moves both ends, one step changes at a time, the menu entries work.

sections.title: macOS
sections.where: MacBook Air M3, Logic Pro and Ableton Live 12
prep: Claude pushes the CI package to the Mac (INSTALL-COMMAND.txt and 'Install test build.command' in the unpacked folder); you run the installer, then hil-mac.command. The Mac must be awake for the push.

items.title: hil-mac on the new build
steps: Run hil-mac.command from the unpacked folder's hil folder (about 5 minutes) and send the result folder.

items.title: Snow plug-in as Audio Unit in Logic
steps: Logic: open the instrument list; insert 'TI Revive Virus Control (Snow)' on a track (the TI2 stands in for a Snow).
items.expect: Both units listed; the Snow one shows the Snow editor with 4 parts, plays sound; the normal unit still shows the TI editor.

items.title: Timing exports
steps: Export the timing test loop (short 16th notes, 120 BPM) at 44.1 kHz / buffer 128 and at 48 kHz / buffer 128; send both WAVs.
items.expect: Claude runs timing_analysis.py: no missing or extra notes, jitter about 0.3 ms or less (E316/E317 left a 2.5 ms note at 44.1/128).

items.title: Mod wheel in Live 12
steps: Live 12, TI Revive (VST3 or AU): draw a mod wheel envelope on a patch that uses it, play it.
items.expect: The mod wheel is audible (not yet tested in Ableton, #18).
